amends: PREREG-amend-4.json is not changed. Registered before the code change it describes. Ticket GoodQA goodqa#16096.
what_happened: The single stamped run of amend-4 (code commit d3e1456e28ddc0d8cf87dab81354f80384c03358, artifacts in the agent work directory, not committed) scored the fresh held-out set once, in item12c, with the repaired scanner. Figures from that first and only scoring: fresh held-out 800 of 960 complete redaction (83.33%, Wilson 95% lower 0.8084), detected 800, whole-string-absent 800; the four cells that scored 0 of 40 were bearer/dot_split, bearer/tab_split, pem/dot_split and pem/tab_split; every other cell 40 of 40. Tuned set 400 of 400 (Wilson lower 0.9905). Burned held-out 800 of 800 (Wilson lower 0.9952). Fresh benign false positives 0 of 720. The same run showed two defects that were not about the scanner's held-out figure: (1) item 4 (provenance) fell from 7 to 0 on quote-back-flagged and history-resend-no-gap, because its hosts resend the same user text each turn and, under the amend-4 contract, a host with repeating content must declare new_count or the ingester emits flagged extra events and blocks; (2) the tap-on cost of item 6 and item 9 rose about threefold with an injected block present, because the scanner now tries many more decoders on every token of the roughly 1 KB injected block.

decisions.item4_hosts: The item 4 hosts declare new_count=1 on every call (Rig.call_kw). This is stated in CLAIMS.md: the provenance counts are measured on hosts that declare the boundary. No threshold changes.
decisions.scanner_performance: scan.py gets a PERFORMANCE-ONLY change (memoised token decoding). Semantics must not change. Check, committed with its result before the rerun: the old scanner (git blob at d3e1456) and the new scanner return identical Finding lists, and identical redacted text, on every example of the tuned set, the burned held-out set, both benign sets and the fresh set (n about 4,000). Only equality counts are recorded; the fresh set's scores are not printed by this check. No pattern or decoder is added, removed or edited.
decisions.scoring_once: The fresh held-out set was scored once, in the first run, and the figures above are THE held-out result. The rerun of the whole suite at the new commit re-executes item12c with an unchanged-in-meaning scanner; its figures must equal the ones above exactly. If they do not equal them, the rerun figure is reported as the figure of a changed scanner, the first figures remain the held-out result, and the difference is explained. No scanner pattern or decoder is edited after this amendment, whatever the fresh result: the four 0 of 40 cells (a separator between every character of a bearer header or a key block) are reported as an open scanner gap.
decisions.rerun: All items are rerun once more on a clean tree at the new commit into ingest/results4 (the first run's artifacts were never committed). item 6 and item 9 thresholds are unchanged; if they fail on the loaded machine the failure is reported, not hidden.
